Ivy (CSM): Borealis private VPC onboarding quick roundup: outstanding items = NAT IPs for firewall, IAM role/trust, CMK policy & alias, audit log retention. Can we do short status pls?

Omar (Net Eng): Waiting on Borealis for their egress NAT pool. They sent subnets 10.250.0.0/16 but not NAT IPs. Recommend ports: 443 -> proxy, 5228 for metrics, SSH to bastion from their corp CIDR only.

Nina (SRE): CMK: they created alias/bor-cmk and key-id "0a1b2c3d-4e5f". Our infra expects alias/redwood-customer-*. Short-term we can reference key-id in deploy; long-term ask them to add alias to match pattern.

Theo (Security): Audit retention: Borealis keeps CloudTrail 60d. Our baseline is 365d for private deployments. This is a renewal risk unless they accept archival to Glacier after 30d. Ivy, can you run cost delta?

Ivy (CSM): Will send cost delta and propose Glacier lifecycle. Also asked them to add our runner role ARN to the CMK key policy; they said they'll update tonight.

Omar (Net Eng): For firewall sample we suggested:
```
allow tcp 443 from 10.250.0.0/16 to 10.9.1.10/32
allow tcp 5228 from 10.250.5.0/24 to 10.9.1.11/32
allow tcp 22 from 198.51.100.0/24 to 10.9.1.20/32 (bastion)
```
I'll apply once NAT IPs arrive.

Nina (SRE): Runbook update: if alias != alias/redwood-customer-borealis, use key-id fallback and create follow-up ticket CS-70021 to ensure alias rename before rotation.

certs-bot: Need collector fqdn + contact to generate cert (PEM). TTL 90d.

Ivy (CSM): Action items:
- Ivy: send retention cost delta + ask security lead to sign off (EOD)
- Omar: apply firewall when NAT IPs provided
- Nina: deploy with key-id fallback and open CS-70021
- Theo: confirm CMK policy once they push update
- Borealis: provide collector fqdn/email for cert
Will follow up in mid-week sync. :thumbsup:
